title: Clinical, Neurophysiological and Radiological Evaluation of Patients With Basal Ganglia Lesions
brief_summary: Basal ganglia are involved in the control of motor, cognitive and emotional behaviours. The aim of this study is to precisely evaluate patients with basal ganglia focal lesions both with or without loss of psychic-self activation.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Basal ganglia lesions

Exclusion Criteria:

* Contraindication to magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
* Dementia
study_population: Patients with lesion of the basal ganglia structures
